acceptance: Workflow tests: schedule + dispatch triggers; the skip path set is a superset of the reuse guarded inputs (test imports both); same shard matrix as release-v2 (asserted against the live release-v2.yml); evidence names include the source sha
Negative test: a run where zero cells executed fails with a named reason
Concurrency: trunk-uat does not start (summary 'deferred: release-v2 run <id> in progress') while any release-v2 run is in progress; test plus documented check

G12 calibration before merge: at least one hosted run via a temporary push trigger on the batch integration branch completes; wall time, runner-hours and per-shard state are recorded here; the temporary trigger is removed before the final PR
After merge: a scheduled or dispatched run on develop succeeds, and a following scheduled run with no relevant change skips in under 5 minutes with 'skipped: unchanged since <sha>'
Per-cell history from the calibration run is readable by the rv2r-04 and rv2r-11 scripts
After the calibration run, every open tracker item whose id matches `release-uat-*` or `*-uat-failures-20261030` is finished with that run's cell evidence or updated with its current cell history
No change to stage configs, timeouts, memory limits, validators or floors
context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation (see rv2r-01 for names and live-evidence order). Prior art: release-v2.yml uat-stage1/2/3 (parallel since #3946); the deleted throwaway release-uat-dryrun workflow is the precedent for the temporary push trigger. GUARDRAILS: 16 shards hold 16 of 20 Free-plan concurrent jobs for about 3 h; keep the 02:00 UTC schedule and a concurrency group that prevents overlap. Do not edit tests/uat or docker/ on develop until 0.5.0 is on PyPI. DECISION GATE: if calibration shows more than 30 runner-hours per run, or the matrix cannot finish within the 6 h job limit, stop and ask the owner.
description: Owner decision 2026-11-05: UAT becomes a continuous property of trunk. Add `.github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml` (02:00 UTC schedule plus workflow_dispatch) that runs the three release-gate stage configs as the parallel shard jobs release-v2 uses, against the trunk dist of the newest develop commit that has one (selection rule from rv2r-09). Skip rule: a scheduled run skips when nothing in the skip path set changed since the last completed scheduled run (green or red); workflow_dispatch always runs. The skip path set is the union of GUARDED_TREES imported from scripts/release_reuse_uat_evidence.py, benchbox/, uv.lock, .github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml and .github/workflows/release-v2.yml (imported, not duplicated). Reuse the release-uat-env action, the shard matrix and make uat-gate-check; do not fork the harness. Each run uploads shard evidence and a gate summary (90-day retention) bound to the source commit and dist digest, and appends per-cell results (terminal state, elapsed, peak memory, failure signature, attempt number) to a history store readable by scripts, so flake and envelope data exist between releases. The run fails when zero cells executed (fail-closed detector 3). It does not start while a release-v2 run is in progress. Rollback: revert the workflow commit; release-v2's full-UAT fallback is unchanged.
